reason: R8: 'i can't see' is the reason for the ask; the ask 'make it brighter' is a relative amount with no absolute value (§2 Levels, R4/R1), so []. R6 does not fire because the request's own action is the relative one.
R2 applies mechanically: two supported actions give both calls as a multiset, 'all lights' / 'my house' = whole house (§2 ROOMS). The contract has no rule for contradictory action pairs (flagged).
R6 serves indirect wording only when exactly one call follows; 'dark' could mean off or a lower level (relative, unservable), and §2 lists 'dark' among values the app lacks, so [].

§3 Times: date/time words in a reminder request are the reminder's own (cf. the dentist example); 'afternoon' is a time-of-day word with no clock time, a vague reminder time, [] under R1. Stratum N1 because the contract classes it as an unexpressible qualifier (R1), not missing information.

'set a reminder alarm for my five p. m. meeting' fits both set_alarm(17:00) (meeting as R8 purpose) and create_reminder(meeting, 17:00); R7 is the only place alternatives are allowed, so the contract cannot give one answer: ambiguous.
